items.label: Why do you call yourself a wizard?
items.prompt: Explain why Icaro Glauco uses the title Wizard of Transformation and connect the metaphor to his actual software practice.

fallback.answer: Wizard is a working metaphor for transformation: Icaro reads diffuse requirements, names the parts, composes a model and turns it into an interface, an agent or an operational product.

card.title: Wizard of Transformation
card.summary: The title describes a method, not a costume.

sections.heading: The transformation
items: A workflow becomes an interface and executable software.

items.label: Show me Cognoscere / Lumira
items.prompt: Present Cognoscere and Lumira as the flagship project. Explain their relationship, core domains and the most important current implementation boundary.

items.label: How does Isocon use local AI?
items.prompt: Explain the Isocon Licitações Inteligentes workflow, focusing on local AI, edital analysis and documentary compliance.

items.label: How does MacroObras connect field and office?
items.prompt: Explain how MacroObras connects administrative planning, field routines, camera evidence and measurement progression.

items.label: Compare the three projects
items.prompt: Compare Cognoscere/Lumira, Isocon Licitações Inteligentes and MacroObras by domain, knowledge model, operational flow and demonstrated capability.

items.label: What can I hire you to build?
items.prompt: Based only on the profile and projects, describe the categories of specialised software Icaro is prepared to design and build.
